description: Form 8582 instructions, line 4 example: 'Part I, line 1d, has a loss of $3,000 and line 2d has a gain of $100. The combined loss on line 3 is $2,900. You enter $2,900 ... on Part II, line 4'. With modified AGI under $100,000 the whole $2,900 is allowed: nothing carried over, AGI = 50,000 + 100 − 3,000 = $47,100.
